summary: Tetra Tech filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026 announcing that its Board of Directors authorized a $500 million increase to its existing share repurchase program, bringing total available repurchases to $898 million, more than double the prior remaining authorization at the end of fiscal Q3 2026. The company cited confidence in its long-term growth outlook, noting $567 million in operating cash flow and $322 million returned to shareholders over the trailing twelve months, with net debt leverage at 0.88x. No price, timeline, or advisor was specified; buybacks will be executed at management's discretion. Watch for execution pace relative to cash generation and any acceleration signaling undervaluation.
